topic: 字母、声音与自我介绍 · Independent new scenario: an evening community class and its new classmates
grammarFocus: 人称代词 I / you；be 动词 am / are；句首大写与句号。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.
sourcePolicy: Project-original scenario; simulated figures and people; no copied official test, textbook, GitHub PDF or third-party audio.
title: New Faces at the Evening Class
instructions: 这是为A0初学者设计的原创听力与语法练习，场景为模拟的社区夜校。请先听或读对话，注意人称代词 I / you 和 be 动词 am / are 的用法，以及句首大写和句号。所有题目均为英文，解释为中文。答案必须来自原文。
transcript:
Narrator: It is 7 p.m. Anna opens the door.
Anna: Hello. I am Anna. Are you a new student?
Ben: Yes. I am Ben. Nice to meet you.
Anna: Nice to meet you, too. You are in Room 3.
Ben: Thank you. Are you the teacher?
Anna: No, I am not. I am a student. I am new, too.
Ben: Oh! You are a student. I am happy.
Anna: We are classmates. This is Tom. He is a student.
Ben: Hello, Tom. Are you new?
Tom: No, I am not. I am not new here. You are new.
Ben: Yes. I am new. We are all in Room 3.

questions.explanation: 旁白先说 It is 7 p.m.，即晚上七点。题目问时间，不是在问后面的房间号码。
旁白说 Anna opens the door.，明确是 Anna 开门。后面 Ben 和 Tom 说话，不代表他们做了开门这个动作。

questions.prompt: Use ONE NUMBER: You are in Room ______.
questions.explanation: Anna 告诉 Ben：You are in Room 3.。题目要求一个数字，空格只填 3；Room 已经给出，不重复写入。
Ben 问 Are you the teacher?，Anna 回答 No, I am not.。问题用第三人称问 Anna，因此回答为 No, she is not；这不是仅凭她是学生推断她不能同时当老师。
questions.evidence:
Ben: Thank you. Are you the teacher?
Anna: No, I am not. I am a student. I am new, too.

questions.prompt: How does Ben feel? Use ONE WORD from the conversation: "I am ______."
questions.explanation: 题目明确问 Ben 的感受。得知 Anna 也是学生后，他说 I am happy.，所以填 happy（高兴）。new 表示是否新来，不是本题问的感受。
questions.evidence: Ben: Oh! You are a student. I am happy.

questions.prompt: What does Anna say about Tom?
questions.explanation: Anna 介绍 Tom 时说 This is Tom. He is a student.，因此选 He is a student。Tom 随后明确说自己不是新来的，所以不能选 He is the new student。
questions.evidence: This is Tom. He is a student.

questions.explanation: Ben 问 Tom 是否新来，Tom 明确回答 No, I am not. I am not new here.。不要把后面的 You are new 误当作 Tom 描述自己；you 指他正在交谈的人。
questions.evidence:
Ben: Hello, Tom. Are you new?
Tom: No, I am not. I am not new here. You are new.

questions.prompt: Use ONE WORD from the conversation: Anna says, "We are ______."
questions.explanation: Anna 的原话是 We are classmates.，表示“我们是同学”。这里 we 指不止一个人，classmates 用复数。题目要求录音中的一个词，应保留原词末尾的 s。

grammar.title: 人称代词 I / you 与 be 动词 am / are；句首大写与句号
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，主语是 I 时，be 动词用 am；主语是 you 时，be 动词用 are。句子第一个字母要大写，句子末尾要加句号。例如：I am Anna. You are a student. 注意：I 永远大写。
grammar.example: I am Anna. Are you a new student?

questions.explanation: I 必须大写，句末要有句号。
主语 you 后面用 are。
主语 I 后面用 am。
主语 you 后面用 are。

questions.prompt: Which sentence has a capital letter and a full stop?
questions.explanation: 句首字母大写，句末有句号。
一般疑问句把 are 放在 you 前面。

speaking.part2: Describe yourself in a new class. You should say:
part3: Are you and your classmates happy?
Are you new in the class?

transfer.writing: Write 2–8 simple sentences about yourself in a new evening class. Use I am, You are, and We are. End each sentence with a full stop.
